name: TCRBreastSEQRSCodeSystem
title: 台灣癌症登記 放療與手術順序（SEQRS）
description: Taiwan Cancer Registry code table for SEQRS (放療與手術順序). 碼冊出處：Longform p.220-222 放射治療與手術順序 (#4.2.1.5). Generated from tcr_decoder; every code round-trips through decode/encode (tests/test_codebook_conformance.py).

concept.display: 首次癌症療程中有手術也有放射治療，但順序未明。
concept.definition: 首次癌症療程中有手術也有放射治療，但順序未明。 / Sequence unknown: the first course had both surgery and radiation therapy, but the order is not documented

designation.value: Sequence unknown: the first course had both surgery and radiation therapy, but the order is not documented

concept.display: 有兩次以上原發部位或區域淋巴結手術，無法決定與放射治療的順序。
concept.definition: 有兩次以上原發部位或區域淋巴結手術，無法決定與放射治療的順序。 / More than two primary-site or regional-node surgeries with radiation therapy in between, so the sequence cannot be determined

designation.value: More than two primary-site or regional-node surgeries with radiation therapy in between, so the sequence cannot be determined

concept.display: 結內淋巴癌、血液腫瘤疾病或遠端轉移個案；或首次療程包含手術及放射治療，但治療範圍不同。
concept.definition: 結內淋巴癌、血液腫瘤疾病或遠端轉移個案；或首次療程包含手術及放射治療，但治療範圍不同。 / Not comparable: nodal lymphoma, a haematologic malignancy, distant metastasis, or a first course including surgery and radiation aimed at different sites

designation.value: Not comparable: nodal lymphoma, a haematologic malignancy, distant metastasis, or a first course including surgery and radiation aimed at different sites

concept.display: 首次療程中個案有原發部位及區域淋巴結放射治療，但未接受原發部位及區域淋巴結手術；或無原發部位或區域淋巴結手術，接受遠端部位預防性放射治療。
concept.definition: 首次療程中個案有原發部位及區域淋巴結放射治療，但未接受原發部位及區域淋巴結手術；或無原發部位或區域淋巴結手術，接受遠端部位預防性放射治療。 / No surgery of the primary site or regional nodes (radiation therapy only, including radiation to a distant site)

designation.value: No surgery of the primary site or regional nodes (radiation therapy only, including radiation to a distant site)

concept.display: 不清楚是否有手術或放射治療。
concept.definition: 不清楚是否有手術或放射治療。 / Unknown whether the case had surgery and/or radiation therapy

designation.value: Unknown whether the case had surgery and/or radiation therapy

concept.display: 首次癌症療程中個案未接受放射治療；或首次療程不含放射治療亦不含手術。
concept.definition: 首次癌症療程中個案未接受放射治療；或首次療程不含放射治療亦不含手術。 / No radiation therapy in the first course (with or without surgery)

designation.value: No radiation therapy in the first course (with or without surgery)
